packs.title: Hand-drawn field sprites
packs.author: This repository
packs.notes: Original art written by hand in tools/art/: 16x24 field sprites, 16x16 map tiles and the oversized props. Drawn to sit in the same visual register as SNES-era overworld art; not traced from, or derived from, any commercial release.
